source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: **Wound rolls** of 1 for melee attacks by this unit's models may be re-rolled. When the target is an enemy unit in range of any objective marker, any Wound roll may be re-rolled instead.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
